name: Fuerte de Samaipata
description: Perched on a hilltop in the eastern foothills of the Bolivian Andes, near the town of Samaipata, El Fuerte is a pre-Hispanic ceremonial centre despite its name. Its centrepiece is a huge sculpted rock covered in carved channels, seats and figures, with no parallel elsewhere in the Americas. Ruins of Inca, Chané and Spanish buildings lie scattered around it.
